title.en: Wheel of fortune: the visitor's side (phone)

intro.sr: Na sajmu posetilac skenira QR kod, ostavi kontakt i zavrti točak. Uvek nešto dobije: popust ili besplatan tretman, u obliku koda koji važi jednom. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: At the fair a visitor scans the QR code, leaves their contact and spins the wheel. They always win something: a discount or a free treatment, as a code valid once. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
